school_login_rejected.title: Schulmanager rejected the password for some schools
school_login_rejected.description:
Schulmanager rejected the configured password for: {schools}. Students of these schools are missing.

In Schulmanager, every school has its own account, even when they share the same e-mail address, and each account has its own password. Log in at https://login.schulmanager-online.de and select the school: if the password is refused there as well, set the same password for all your school accounts and reload the integration.

school_two_factor_required.title: Two-factor authentication blocks some schools
school_two_factor_required.description:
The Schulmanager account for these schools has two-factor authentication enabled: {schools}. The integration cannot log in with a code, so students of these schools are missing.

In Schulmanager, every school has its own account, and two-factor authentication is switched on per account. To include these students, turn off two-factor authentication for the account at this school in the Schulmanager settings and reload the integration.
